svg.text: THE TASK IS SAVED BEFORE ANYTHING IS PROPOSED
Type a task the way you would say it out loud
Group meeting about the presentation tomorrow
Pick up shift timesheet from boss today
The table keeps its place while the detail opens beside it. Nothing navigates away,
and the same row stays selected when you come back.
parsed from the word “Friday” — applied, never proposed
Hand in the PDF, not the .docx. Reference list goes last.
Suggest again is always yours to press.
